levels.name: Valley Run
levels.tagline: Pipe to the pumping station. Dry, warm, smooth.

levels.name: Quarry Road
levels.tagline: An excavator up to the quarry. Gravel, and a drizzle starting.

levels.name: Logging Cut
levels.tagline: Logs off the cut. Rain, ruts, and mud down one side.

levels.name: Clay Switch
levels.tagline: A generator to the relay mast. Heavy rain on clay and bare rock.

levels.name: The Wall
levels.tagline: No trailer. Just the truck, a storm, and a slab of wet granite.
